in_text_mentions: A CT of the head, face, and sinuses revealed an NSA with right periorbital cellulitis and bilateral cavernous sinus thrombosis (Figure 1, Figure 2). The patient was admitted to the ICU. Anticoagulation was deferred to minimize the risk of bleeding in the setting of septic sinus thrombosis. Antibiotics were escalated to meropenem and vancomycin.
